title: Talking About Your Family
summary: Learn how to name your family members in English. Practice saying who is in your family using simple words.

sections.p: In English, we use special words for the people in our family. Your mother and father are your parents. A brother is a boy from your mother and father. A sister is a girl from your mother and father. We use the verb 'have' to talk about our family. For example, you can say 'I have one brother' or 'I have a sister'.

ex.mean: Saying you have a male sibling.

sections.p: When people get married, the man is a husband and the woman is a wife. Your son is your boy child. Your daughter is your girl child. Together, they are your children. You can say 'I have two children' to talk about your son and your daughter in a simple and clear way.

ex.mean: Saying you have a girl child.

sections.p: Your mother's parents and your father's parents are your grandparents. The man is your grandfather and the woman is your grandmother. In everyday English, many people call them 'grandpa' and 'grandma' because it sounds friendly and warm. You can say 'My grandparents are very nice'.

tip: Look at photos of your family on your phone. Point to each person and say their English name out loud.

quiz.en: My mother and father are my ___.
A boy from your mother and father is your ___.
This is my ___ . She is married to me.
